insight.headline: GraphQL Admin API Error
insight.what_changed: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering. This change starts in API version 2026-10. Previously, the API would silently return incorrect results.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should update their GraphQL queries to handle the new error response. They should also review their metafield configurations to ensure they are set up correctly for filtering. The `metafield` object in the GraphQL Admin API will now include an `error` field to indicate when a metafield is not set up for filtering. Developers can use this field to handle errors and provide a better user experience.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see more accurate results when using apps that filter by metafields. They will also see error messages when an app tries to filter by a metafield that is not set up correctly.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the accuracy and reliability of the GraphQL Admin API. It also helps developers build more robust and error-free apps.
insight.code_example: query { metafield(namespace: "namespace", key: "key") { value error { message } } }

updates.title: POS UI extensions can now print directly to hardware receipt printers
updates.summary: POS UI extensions can now print directly to hardware receipt printers using the Printing API. This enables extensions to discover and send documents to connected receipt printers.

updates.title: Invalid metafield queries now return errors in the GraphQL Admin API
updates.summary: The GraphQL Admin API now returns errors for invalid metafield queries, starting in API version 2026-10. This change improves the accuracy of query results.

updates.title: Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events
updates.summary: Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events, allowing apps to subscribe to events for various resources and metafield changes.

updates.title: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials
updates.summary: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials, introducing a simpler way to build theme pages.

updates.title: Full-stack capabilities to power app analytics
updates.summary: Full-stack capabilities are now available to power app analytics, making it easier for app developers to build merchant-facing analytics.

updates.title: Physical inventory feature preview
updates.summary: The physical inventory feature preview introduces a new set of inventory APIs in the unstable version of the GraphQL Admin API.
The CLI 4.5.2 release fixes a warning when running theme commands in valid theme directories and bumps Shopify/theme-tools packages.

updates.title: Card deposit endpoint now requires mTLS certificate
updates.summary: The card deposit endpoint now requires a Shopify-issued mTLS client certificate, affecting apps that store cardholder data.

updates.title: @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.2
updates.summary: The @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.2 release adds non-interactive shop and storefront creation flags to hydrogen link and allows bypassing confirmation prompts in hydrogen upgrade.

updates.title: Updated App Store requirements: 4.1.2 Use a unique name for your app
updates.summary: The App Store requirements have been updated to include the use of a unique name for apps, reducing merchant confusion over identical and copied app names.

updates.title: Storefront API `@inContext` supports `channelId`
updates.summary: The Storefront API @inContext directive now supports the channelId argument, allowing the application of a specific sales channel's context to an entire query.

updates.title: `productId`, `title`,`variantSku`, and `variantTitle` fields added to `ExchangeLineItem`
updates.summary: The ExchangeLineItem type has been updated to include the productId, title, variantSku, and variantTitle fields.

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance API functionality, Liquid templates, and app analytics

themes.title: API Enhancements
themes.detail: The GraphQL Admin API now returns errors for invalid metafield queries starting in API version 2026-10, and metafield triggers are available for events. Additionally, the Printing API is introduced for POS UI extensions, enabling direct printing to hardware receipt printers.

themes.title: Liquid Template Improvements
themes.detail: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials, simplifying theme page building. This feature is available in the Liquid July ’26 developer preview.

themes.title: App Development
themes.detail: Full-stack capabilities are now available to power app analytics, allowing developers to build merchant-facing analytics without standing up their own stack.
